So I'm taking 5+3 = 8 damage in the air. I have 10 life. So I will go to 2. Wait, I also need to make sure I don't lose to the 5 damage on the ground.
Wait... what is on the stack? "Ability". What ability triggers when they attack? Masked Blackguard or something? No... wait, does one of their creatures trigger? Ah, "when this creature attacks". "When you control another Rogue, this gets something"? Masked Blackguard is a 2/1. Let's block the 3 ground creatures. I'll take 8 from the flyers and drop to 2 life.

Masked Blackguard (2/1) -> block with a 2/2 Elemental token.
Mausoleum Turnkey (3/2) -> block with a 2/2 Elemental token.
Wait, if they trade I lose three 2/2 tokens but survive the ground assault. I will have plenty of power left on my turn.
Could there be pump spells? Yes. So block Gonti with Courser of Kruphix (2/4)? No, Gonti is deathtouch, it will kill Courser. Best to block Gonti with a tiny token.
I'll block Gonti (id=p74) with Elemental (p62).
Block Masked Blackguard (id=p34) with Elemental (p84).
Block Mausoleum Turnkey (id=p79) with Elemental (p93).

annotations.description: Passed the turn with 4 mana available and Phyrexian Debaser as the only castable spell, doing absolutely nothing. There are no instants in hand or activated abilities to hold mana for. The player has no green mana and cannot cast any of their green spells, making Debaser the only productive use of mana this turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, ending the turn with 4 unused mana and no plays made.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Phyrexian Debaser - a 2/2 flyer that provides an evasive clock and a sacrifice ability for removal. With no other legal plays and no reason to hold mana open, deploying the only available threat is clearly correct.

annotations.description: Declined to attack with Phyrexian Rager into an empty board, missing 2 free damage against an opponent at 20 life.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with Phyrexian Rager for 2 unblockable damage. There are no opposing creatures, so the attack is completely risk-free.

annotations.description: Chose Gonti, Lord of Luxury (2/3 deathtouch with card steal) over Baneslayer Angel (5/5 flying, first strike, lifelink), which is one of the most powerful limited creatures ever printed. Baneslayer Angel was a legal casting option and would have immediately dominated the board. The opponent's black-based deck would struggle to remove a 5/5 first striker, and the lifelink would make the race impossible. Gonti provides modest value but doesn't pressure the opponent nearly as much.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Baneslayer Angel - it immediately dominates the board as a 5/5 flying first strike lifelink that the opponent's black creatures cannot profitably block or race against.

annotations.description: Opponent has only Gonti (2/3) as a potential blocker with all lands tapped (no combat tricks possible). Phyrexian Rager already drew its card on ETB, so it's expendable. Either the opponent takes 2 damage or trades their valuable Gonti block for a Rager that already served its purpose. With no tricks possible, this attack is very favorable.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to attack with Phyrexian Rager
annotations.betterLine: Attack with Phyrexian Rager. Opponent either takes 2 damage or blocks with Gonti (killing Rager but Gonti survives at 2/1). Even in the worst case, the Rager already drew a card and pressuring the opponent's life total is important.

annotations.description: Cast Zendikar's Roil (makes 2/2 ground tokens) instead of Phyrexian Debaser when facing a Baneslayer Angel 5/5 flying first strike lifelink. Zendikar's Roil tokens can't block the Angel, and spending all 5 mana here delays Rampaging Baloths (the much more impactful 6-drop) by a turn since they can't play their land drop after casting Roil for 5.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Zendikar's Roil for {3}{G}{G}, using all available mana
annotations.betterLine: Cast Phyrexian Debaser ({3}{B}) for 4 mana, then play Forest from hand. Debaser provides a flying blocker that can interact with Baneslayer Angel (sacrifice for -2/-2), and playing the land sets up 6 mana next turn to cast the much more powerful Rampaging Baloths (6/6 trample + 4/4 tokens).

annotations.description: Failed to activate Evolving Wilds with both Zendikar's Roil and Courser of Kruphix on the battlefield. This would have generated a free 2/2 Elemental token (critical for blocking/attacking against Baneslayer Angel), gained 1 life, and thinned the deck. There is zero downside to activating it, especially with the opponent tapped out.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without activating Evolving Wilds
annotations.betterLine: Activate Evolving Wilds to fetch a basic land, triggering Zendikar's Roil for a 2/2 token and Courser of Kruphix for 1 life gain. Every body matters when facing a 5/5 Baneslayer Angel.

annotations.description: Opponent has no untapped creatures to block and no untapped mana to cast tricks. Phyrexian Rager (2/2) and Courser of Kruphix (2/4) could attack for 4 unblockable damage. With Baneslayer Angel about to start attacking and gaining life, this free damage is critical. Passing up 4 free damage against a lifegain threat is a significant error.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to attack with any creatures.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with both Phyrexian Rager and Courser of Kruphix for 4 free damage, since the opponent has no blockers and no untapped mana for interaction.

annotations.description: Cast Masked Blackguard (a flash creature) during precombat main phase, tapping out of 2 mana. Since it has flash, it could have been held until the opponent's turn for surprise blocking value, or at least cast postcombat to preserve the option of using mana during combat (e.g., if combat plans change). Casting precombat gives the opponent full information about available blockers and leaves no mana up.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Masked Blackguard precombat, tapping out
annotations.betterLine: Attack first with Baneslayer Angel (and possibly Gonti), then either cast Masked Blackguard postcombat or hold it with flash to deploy as a surprise blocker on the opponent's turn when they have multiple ground attackers.

annotations.description: Gem31P passed on attacking when Baneslayer Angel (the opponent's best creature) was tapped and couldn't block. With two expendable Elemental tokens, Phyrexian Rager, and Courser of Kruphix available, attacking into just Gonti (deathtouch), Emancipation Angel 3/3, and Masked Blackguard 2/1 would have pushed through damage. At 14 life vs 25 life with Baneslayer threatening 5 damage + 5 life swing each turn, being passive is very costly. Even just sending the two Elemental tokens forces the opponent to trade valuable creatures or take 4 damage.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed combat without attacking with any creatures.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with at least both Elemental Tokens (2/2 each) and potentially all four available creatures. With only 3 blockers available and Baneslayer tapped, at least 2 damage gets through on an all-out attack, and the opponent is forced into unfavorable trades with expendable tokens. Given the life total disparity and Baneslayer's looming threat, aggression is essential.

annotations.description: With both Zendikar's Roil and Rampaging Baloths on the battlefield, Primeval Herald would generate enormous value by fetching lands on ETB and each attack, creating both 2/2 Elemental tokens and 4/4 Beast tokens with each landfall trigger. Myr Sire is a 1/1 that makes a 1/1 token on death — vastly inferior.
annotations.actionTaken: Chose Myr Sire (1/1 that makes a 1/1 token on death)
annotations.betterLine: Choose Primeval Herald, which would generate massive landfall value with Zendikar's Roil and Rampaging Baloths already on the battlefield, creating 2/2 and 4/4 tokens each time it fetches a land.

annotations.description: Only attacked with Baneslayer Angel when Emancipation Angel (also a flyer) was available to attack unblocked as well. The opponent has zero flying/reach creatures and zero untapped lands, so there was no risk. This missed 3 unblockable damage (opponent goes to 9 instead of 6), which is very significant when the opponent has Rampaging Baloths threatening to generate tokens every turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with only Baneslayer Angel for 5 flying damage
annotations.betterLine: Attack with both Baneslayer Angel and Emancipation Angel for 8 unblockable flying damage, putting opponent to 6 life. Could also consider sending Gonti (deathtouch) to further pressure or force unfavorable blocks.

annotations.description: Player declined to cast Phyrexian Broodlings with available mana while Phyrexian Debaser was on the stack. With 4 untapped lands (including enough black sources for {1}{B}{B}), there was no reason not to deploy an additional 2/2 creature to the board. While the existing board is already strong, leaving mana and a castable creature unused is leaving free value on the table.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting Phyrexian Broodlings
annotations.betterLine: Cast Phyrexian Broodlings for {1}{B}{B} to add another creature to the already dominant board, maximizing pressure and providing an additional body for attacks or blocks.

annotations.description: Player declined to attack with a massive board advantage in a desperate position. At 10 life facing Baneslayer Angel (5/5 lifelink) that will untap next turn, the player needed to be aggressive. Opponent only had Gonti (deathtouch), Masked Blackguard 2/1, and Emancipation Angel (flying) as blockers - meaning at most 2 ground creatures could be effectively blocked. Attacking with everything would deal 12+ damage through, important pressure against an opponent at 30 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to attack with any creatures
annotations.betterLine: Attack with all or nearly all ground creatures (Rampaging Baloths, Beast Token, 3 Elemental Tokens, Courser, Phyrexian Rager). Opponent can only block 2 ground creatures effectively, so 12+ damage gets through. Given the desperate position against Baneslayer Angel, maximizing damage output is critical.

annotations.description: Attacking with all creatures sends ground creatures (Gonti 2/3, Masked Blackguard 2/1, Mausoleum Turnkey 3/2) into a board with Rampaging Baloths 6/6, Beast Token 4/4, Courser 2/4, Elementals 2/2, and Phyrexian Rager 2/2. The opponent can block and kill all three ground creatures. The two flyers alone deal 8 unblockable damage (opponent at 10), putting opponent to 2. Sacrificing ground creatures gains no additional damage but loses valuable blockers against the opponent's massive board that threatens huge crackback damage.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with all five creatures, sending three ground creatures into unfavorable blocks.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with only Baneslayer Angel and Emancipation Angel (8 flying damage, opponent to 2). Keep Gonti (deathtouch), Masked Blackguard, and Mausoleum Turnkey back as blockers against the opponent's threatening board of Baloths, Beast tokens, and Elementals. Next turn the flyers finish the job.

annotations.description: Attacking with all ground creatures (Gonti, Masked Blackguard, Mausoleum Turnkey) into a board with Beast Token 4/4, Rampaging Baloths 6/6, Courser 2/4, and multiple 2/2 Elementals. The opponent can profitably block and kill the ground attackers. Meanwhile Baneslayer Angel (5/5) + Emancipation Angel (3/3) deal 8 unblockable flying damage, putting opponent from 10 to 2 (with 5 life gained from lifelink). The flyers alone represent a 2-turn clock. Sending ground creatures risks losing them for minimal benefit while reducing defensive options against the opponent's growing token army.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with all 5 creatures including 3 ground creatures into a board full of efficient blockers
annotations.betterLine: Attack with only Baneslayer Angel and Emancipation Angel for 8 flying damage (opponent goes to 2). Keep Gonti, Masked Blackguard, and Mausoleum Turnkey back as blockers against the opponent's growing board of tokens and Rampaging Baloths.

annotations.description: At 3 life facing lethal from Baneslayer Angel (5/5 flying first strike), Emancipation Angel (3/3 flying), and Gonti (2/3), the player passed without blocking, taking 10 damage and dying. They had a survival line: block Baneslayer with Phyrexian Debaser (flying), then before first strike damage sacrifice Debaser to give Emancipation Angel -2/-2 (making it 1/1), and block Gonti with Beast Token. Only 1 damage from the now-1/1 Emancipation gets through, surviving at 2 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed without declaring any blockers, taking 10 damage at 3 life (lethal).
annotations.betterLine: Block Baneslayer Angel with Phyrexian Debaser, block Gonti with Beast Token (sick creatures can still block). Before first strike damage, activate Phyrexian Debaser's sacrifice ability to give Emancipation Angel -2/-2, reducing it to 1/1. Only 1 point of flying damage gets through, surviving at 2 life.
